entities.name: Royal Academy of Magic
entities.description: Academy of wizards in Krov, capital of Kjeldor, that crumbled in the Thaw.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: Head of the academy and most powerful recognized wizard in Kjeldor, killed in Lim-Dul's Battle.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Sneaked into the tower and reclaimed Jodah's mirror.

entities.name: Lim-Dul's Battle
entities.description: Battle in which Gustha was killed.

entities.name: Zur
entities.description: Wizard whose followers some spellcasters joined.

entities.name: Darien
entities.description: Leader unwilling to support one faction over others.

entities.name: Cult of Rimewind
entities.description: Cult that used Krov's libraries to find Phyrexian war machines.

events.summary: Jaya Ballard snuck into Gustha's tower and reclaimed Jodah's mirror from her owl familiar.
events.quote: Jaya Ballard snuck into her tower and reclaimed Jodah's mirror from Gustha's owl familiar

events.summary: Gustha was killed in Lim-Dul's Battle and the spellcaster groups went their separate ways, crumbling the academy.
events.quote: the academy quickly crumbled in the first period of the Thaw

events.summary: The academy fell with Krov when Garza Zol took control.
events.quote: The Royal Academy as an institution finally fell along with the rest of the city of Krov when Garza Zol took control over it.

relations.quote: the academy was led by Gustha Ebbasdotter
